title: Age of Mythology: Retold – Update 19.14612
description: Welcome heroes to another exciting update for Age of Mythology: Retold! Are you ready to level up your gameplay experience? This update adds new content like a fresh Random Map for Obsidian Mirror owners, expanded Demeter gameplay, along with a bounty of balance changes, bug fixes, and performance enhancements to keep your battles running even more smoothly. As always, take a moment to explore the full list of changes before jumping in and enjoying them in game!
